achievements.label: First Herd
achievements.description: Grow your herd for the first time.

achievements.label: First Steps
achievements.description: Make your first decoupling investment (Feed Additives, Herd Caps, or Capture Systems).

achievements.label: Full Toolkit
achievements.description: Invest in Feed Additives, Herd Caps, and Capture Systems at least once each.

achievements.label: Quarter Decoupled
achievements.description: Cut your emissions-per-herd-unit ratio to at least 25% below baseline.

achievements.label: Half Decoupled
achievements.description: Cut your emissions-per-herd-unit ratio to at least 50% below baseline.

achievements.label: Nearly Fully Decoupled
achievements.description: Cut your emissions-per-herd-unit ratio to at least 90% below baseline.

achievements.label: Plant Pioneer
achievements.description: Make your first Plant-Based Pivot investment.

achievements.label: Half the Farm
achievements.description: Shift at least 30% of output to plant-based production.

achievements.label: Pivot Complete
achievements.description: Shift the maximum possible 60% of output to plant-based production.

achievements.label: Real-World Match
achievements.description: Match the real documented ~42% methane-intensity reduction farms have actually achieved.

achievements.label: Beating the Baseline
achievements.description: Have a higher score than a pure-growth farm with the exact same herd size, 5+ rounds in.

achievements.label: Decoupling Dividend
achievements.description: Out-score a pure-growth farm with the same herd size by 50 points or more.

achievements.label: Clean Operator
achievements.description: Reach round 15 while never letting market/regulatory pressure exceed 10% income loss.

achievements.label: Thriving Farm
achievements.description: Reach a score of 400 or higher.
